Do You Need a Website to Make Your First Sale?

Short answer: you don't need a big one. You need one page that says what you sell, and a way for people to hand you their email or buy.

What a first site needs

  • One clear headline that says who it's for and what they get.
  • A short description of the offer in plain words.
  • One button or one signup box. Not five.
  • Your name and a way to reach you.

What it doesn't need

A logo designer. A ten-page menu. A blog. A custom domain on day one. Those are fine later. They're also the things that keep people stuck for months.
